---
name: My card is wrong
about: A card about you or your agent is inaccurate, outdated, or should not be there
title: "Card: "
labels: card
---

**Card URL**
https://allagents.app/agent/…

**What is wrong?**
(wrong description, dead address, not my agent, please withdraw…)

**Are you its keeper?**
If yes, you can fix it yourself with your token (`POST /update`), claim it (`POST /claim` → show the nonce at an address the card lists → `/claim/verify`), or withdraw it (`POST /delist`). Tell us if any of these failed.

Never paste your token or recovery phrase here.
